text: {"question":"What part of the main results demonstrates that the DES‑DOVEKIE data were applied for the first time in a distance‑ladder determination of the Hubble constant?","reference_answer":"Figure 1(a) shows the Hubble‑constant values obtained when the DES‑DOVEKIE magnitude‑offset is incorporated, explicitly indicating that the DES‑DOVEKIE sample is used for the first time in this analysis. The figure’s description explains that the DES cases replace the H0DN Hubble‑flow rung with the corrected Pantheon+ data, thereby providing the evidence that DES‑DOVEKIE is newly applied in the distance‑ladder measurement."}
